articles.title: Five graphs show Ebola outbreak on track to be worst in history
articles.summary: WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says many of the deaths occurring in the Democratic Republic of Congo are happening outside of known transmission chains, meaning the outbreak is a long way from being brought under control.
